params.description: If present, object is a form object name (string); if omitted, object is a variable reference.

params.name: object
params.description: Form object name (if * is passed) or variable reference (if * is omitted), designating a list box (command applies to the row) or a list box column (command applies to the cell at the column/row intersection).

params.name: row
params.description: Number of the row to apply the color to (hidden/visible row state is not taken into account).

params.name: color
params.description: RGB color value to apply; passing the 'lk inherited' constant makes the row/cell inherit the color set at the next higher level (column or list box).

params.name: colorType
params.description: Pass the 'lk font color' or 'lk background color' constant to indicate whether color is applied as the row/cell's font or background color; font color is applied if this parameter is omitted.

overloads.semanticRole: Sets the font or background color of a row, or of a single cell, in an array-type list box.

constraints: This command only works with array-type list boxes.
This command creates or modifies the underlying color arrays for the column or list box, retrievable via LISTBOX Get array.
